title: Forward implication for constructibility with integral coefficients
statement: theorem isConstructibleSheaf_integral_forward {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : X.IsTorsionAbelianSheaf F) : let E := (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).inv ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ ≃+* ℤ).toRingHom IsConstructibleSheaf ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology E).obj F) → IsConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F)

source.place: Definition 03RW (definition-constructible), parts (2) and (3), and Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated); integral torsion specialization and underlying-set comparison written by Q1 for step 5 of lem-weil-pbc-curve-assertions-retract. proof.text: The forward implication is proved by transporting a finite stratification through the coefficient equivalence and forgetting to sets. Torsion stalks that are finitely generated integral modules are finite.
